errors.evidence: The y-axis has labeled ticks at intervals of 20 (30, 50, 70, 90). While there are grid lines at 10-unit intervals, the tick labels are only present every 20 units.

The blue line (3-Model Ensemble) starts at a reliability score of approximately 83. Stating it as 85, in conjunction with stating the red line's start value as 84, incorrectly reverses the initial ranking of the two models; in the plot, the red line starts with a higher score than the blue line.

The red line (2-Model Ensemble) starts at a reliability score of approximately 86. Stating the value as 84, in conjunction with stating the blue line's start value as 85, incorrectly reverses the initial ranking of the two models; in the plot, the red line actually starts with a higher score than the blue line.

The final reliability score for the GPT-4 model (yellow line) at a cost of 10 is approximately 42. The data point is visibly above the midpoint between 30 and 50 (which represents 40). The value 38 is an inaccurate underestimation.
